headline: North Korean hacking group Lazarus strikes! 30 servers in South Korea targeted; Asia-Pacific becomes hardest-hit area | ETtoday International News
summary: The North Korean hacking group Lazarus reportedly exploited PHP vulnerabilities to target servers across many countries. South Korea has 30 servers listed as targets, ranking fourth among 10 countries.
why: State-linked cyberattacks on servers and financial infrastructure create operational and reputational risks for companies and can prompt security spending.
